recentItems.title: Rams vs 49ers in Austrailia
recentItems.description: We're breaking down the upcoming NFL football game in Australia: massive time-zone shifts, long travel logistics, and why teams must scrub equipment to avoid invasive species... Becoming the Aussie fan favs, the 49ers have been there longer for fan activations while the Rams just arrived... will you be tuning in? 🏈

recentItems.title: AI Researcher Quits: "It's As Bad As You Think"
recentItems.description: A researcher who worked at OpenAI and Anthropic, Jacob Coxon, says both companies are moving too fast with “zero regard” for safety checks and are “gambling with our lives.” Superhuman AI could take away livelihoods and trigger “warfare on Earth,” 😳 We cannot let this continue.

recentItems.title: AI Could Shut Down EVERYTHING
recentItems.description: A Tech Investor warns that advanced AI could disable critical infrastructure: electric grids, phone towers, even ATMs, causing chaos while impersonating humans for sabotage missions. This has to be stopped before it gets even crazier 😬
